name: The Equalizer
description: Robert McCall is a former agent of a secret government agency who is now running his own private crime fighting operation where he fashions himself as "The Equalizer." It is a service for victims of the system who have exhausted all possible means of seeking justice and have nowhere to go. McCall promises to even out the odds for them.

videos.title: The Story of The Equalizer
videos.overview: The Story of The Equalizer featuring interviews with William Zabka (Scott McCall), Keith Szarabajka (Mickey Kostmayer) and producers Coleman Luck and Robert Eisele.

videos.title: Pilot: The Equalizer
videos.overview: A former government agent offers his services to people facing problems too big for them to handle, such as a woman being stalked by a psychopath and a man who learns of a blackmail scheme involving government officials.

videos.title: China Rain
videos.overview: McCall comes to the aid of a housekeeper when kidnappers grab her son by mistake.

videos.title: The Defector
videos.overview: McCall helps a double agent defect and a young boy stand up to bullies.

videos.title: The Lock Box
videos.overview: McCall helps a man whose daughter has been abducted by a pimp who services covert government operations.

videos.title: Lady Cop
videos.overview: A crooked cop is willing to murder to ensure that his new partner won't blow the whistle on his operations.

videos.title: The Confirmation Day
videos.overview: McCall helps a former showgirl convinced someone is stalking her and a boy whose father helped steal antiques now wanted by two separate parties.

videos.title: The Children's Song

videos.title: Mama's Boy

videos.title: Bump and Run

videos.title: Back Home

videos.title: Wash Up

videos.title: Unnatural Causes

videos.title: Prelude

videos.title: A Community of Civilized Men

videos.title: Nightscape

videos.title: Counterfire

videos.overview: A young girl runs away from her quarreling parents and into the hands of a child pornographer.

videos.overview: McCall and a former terrorist, now a monk, are both searching for the monk's former partner, a terrorist who uses plastic surgery after each assignment to keep ahead of his enemies.

videos.title: Blood & Wine (2)
videos.overview: McCall and a former terrorist, now a monk, are both searching for the monk's former partner, a terrorist who uses plastic surgery after each assignment to keep ahead of his enemies.

videos.title: Suspicion of Innocence

videos.overview: The trading on Wall Street gets a little rough; McCall and Mickey pull a half-drowned woman from the river after she gets in the way of some ruthless manipulators.

videos.title: Encounter in a Closed Room
videos.overview: McCall tries to help a European defector free her parents from the KGB, who have kidnaped them to exert pressure on her to persuade another defector to return to their homeland.

videos.title: Mission: McCall (1)
videos.overview: Scott discovers that his father has been kidnapped by someone, and following his father's instructions, contacts an old Company colleague, Richard Dyson, who sets things in motion to find out who has McCall and to get him back.

videos.title: Mission: McCall (2)
videos.overview: Scott discovers that his father has been kidnapped by someone, and following his father's instructions, contacts an old Company colleague, Richard Dyson, who sets things in motion to find out who has McCall and to get him back.

videos.overview: McCall helps a fellow Intelligence officer stay alive despite someone's efforts to keep him from talking to a Congressional committee.

videos.title: Inner View
videos.overview: A psychic can't convince the police that she has `seen' the next attack of a serial killer, so she turns to McCall for help in preventing it.

videos.overview: McCall asks Harley to help him handle a request for help from a six-year-old AIDS victim who is living with his grandmother and facing increasingly violent harassment from the frightened and angry neighbors.

videos.title: A Dance on the Dark Side
videos.overview: A police station switchboard operator overhears a detective discussing the murder of his former partner and goes to McCall for help when she receives threats to keep her quiet.

videos.title: The Child Broker
videos.overview: A young woman asks McCall to help her boyfriend break away from the control of a junior Fagin.

videos.title: Video Games
videos.overview: A reporter's wife asks McCall to find her husband, who has disappeared while working undercover on a call-girl operation involving blackmail and the death of his daughter.

videos.title: Something Green
videos.overview: The ex-wife of a European diplomat asks McCall to help her retrieve her son from his father before he can leave the country with the boy and $10 million in mob money.

videos.title: The Mystery of Manon (1)
videos.overview: Yvette Marcel asks her godfather Control and McCall for help dealing with her irrational father, who is intent on locating Manon, the mother she believed had been killed years before.

videos.title: The Mystery of Manon (2)
videos.overview: Yvette Marcel asks her godfather Control and McCall for help dealing with her irrational father, who is intent on locating Manon, the mother she believed had been killed years before.

videos.title: No Place Like Home
videos.overview: McCall comes to the aid of a recently dispossessed man and his family who has been moved in a welfare hotel and is facing pressure from the landlord to take part in his welfare scams.

videos.title: Last Call

videos.title: Regrets Only
videos.overview: A young woman trying to start her life over faces continuing harassment from her upscale, professional husband who won't let her go but who is smart enough to conceal his activities.

videos.title: Sea of Fire
videos.overview: A desperate high school principal calls on McCall for help in combating the gang responsible for the rape of a girl in the school gymnasium.

videos.title: Riding the Elephant

videos.title: The Visitation
videos.overview: McCall's reunion with a former lover is interrupted when her medical skills are needed to deal with a deadly virus being carried by a pair of thugs responsible for killing an international arms dealer.

videos.title: Past Imperfect

videos.overview: McCall tries to help a young woman who is one of the victims of a series of robberies directed against the deaf community.

videos.title: Lullaby of Darkness

videos.title: 17 Zebra

videos.title: Starfire

videos.title: The Caper

videos.title: Heart of Justice
videos.overview: A bitter man tries to get revenge on the men who brutalized his wife but he calls McCall when someone else gets them first.

videos.title: Race Traitors
videos.overview: McCall answers a call for help from Kostmayer's old neighborhood, where a racist group is harassing a black family.

videos.title: Endgame
videos.overview: McCall helps two sisters whom are the victims of a revenge that has been plotted by a master strategy game player.

videos.title: Suicide Squad
videos.overview: McCall comes to the aid of a college student who's lost his athletic scholarship and fears disappointing his parents, and turns to drug dealing as a way to make the big money they expect.

awards: Nominated for 7 Primetime Emmys. 2 wins & 11 nominations total
